nodes.description: Public payable mint function guarded by nonReentrant; enforces sale active, max supply, per-tx limit and payment before minting.
Public free mint function guarded by nonReentrant; enforces sale active and free supply cap before minting.
View function returning current value of supplyCounter.
onlyOwner function toggling the saleIsActive flag.
onlyOwner function that forwards a new base URI to the delegated base contract.
onlyOwner function that updates the extensionURI state variable.
View function concatenating the base token URI with the extensionURI.
nonReentrant onlyOwner function that sends the contract balance to the owner via Address.sendValue.
Constant maximum total supply (10000).
Constant maximum free supply (420).
Constant maximum per-transaction paid mint count (20).
Constant maximum per-transaction free mint count (5).
Constant mint price per token (0.02 ETH).
Mutable URI extension appended to token URIs.
Counters.Counter tracking minted supply.
Boolean flag gating mint and freeMint.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient and as the identity checked by onlyOwner.
Arithmetic expression totalSupply() + count - 1 used for the MAX_SUPPLY bound check.
Arithmetic expression PRICE * count used for the payment requirement.
Address.sendValue low-level call forwarding the full balance to the owner address.
Arithmetic expression totalSupply() + count - 1 used for the MAX_FREE_SUPPLY bound check.
User-supplied mint quantity argument of mint.
User-supplied mint quantity argument of freeMint.
New value assigned to the saleIsActive flag.
New base URI forwarded to the base contract.
New extension string stored in extensionURI.
Token id queried for its URI.
Local variable holding address(this).balance before transfer.

edges.reason: count parameter flows into mint supply and payment checks.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient.
mint calls totalSupply for supply bound checks and token ids.
mint reads MAX_SUPPLY in the supply bound check.
mint reads MAX_MULTIMINT for the per-tx limit.
mint reads PRICE for the payment requirement.
mint requires saleIsActive to be true to proceed.
mint increments supplyCounter for each minted token.
mint computes totalSupply() + count - 1 for the supply bound.
mint computes PRICE * count for the payment bound.
count parameter flows into freeMint supply checks.
msg.sender is used as the freeMint recipient.
freeMint calls totalSupply for supply bound checks and token ids.
freeMint reads MAX_FREE_SUPPLY in the supply bound check.
freeMint reads MAX_FREE_MULTIMINT for the per-tx limit.
freeMint requires saleIsActive to be true to proceed.
freeMint increments supplyCounter for each minted token.
freeMint computes totalSupply() + count - 1 for the supply bound.
setSaleIsActive writes the saleIsActive flag.
saleIsActive_ parameter is stored into saleIsActive.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender against the delegated owner.
customBaseURI_ parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender against the delegated owner.
customExtensionURI_ parameter is stored into extensionURI.
setExtensionURI writes the extensionURI state variable.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender against the delegated owner.
tokenId parameter is used to build the token URI.
tokenURI reads extensionURI when composing the URI.
totalSupply reads supplyCounter.current().
withdraw reads address(this).balance into the local balance variable.
withdraw forwards balance to Address.sendValue low-level call.
withdraw is gated by onlyOwner, which checks msg.sender.
External ETH transfer to the owner address can re-enter withdraw.

normalization_plan.reason: count parameter only exists as mint input and should fold into mint.
count parameter only exists as freeMint input and should fold into freeMint.
saleIsActive_ parameter is written directly by setSaleIsActive and should fold into it.
customBaseURI_ parameter is consumed directly by setBaseURI and should fold into it.
customExtensionURI_ parameter is consumed directly by setExtensionURI and should fold into it.
tokenId parameter is consumed directly by tokenURI and should fold into it.
balance local var is computed inside withdraw and should fold into it.
